description: This bar chart illustrates the task count for different language families across three model types: mBERT, XLM-R, and “same”. The horizontal axis represents language family, with labels including “IE-Baltic”, “IE-Germanic”, “IE-Indic”, “IE-Romance”, “IE-Slavic”, “IE-other”, “Isolate”, “Semitic”, and “Uralic”, presented in that order. The vertical axis, labeled “task count”, displays a linear scale ranging from 0 to 40, with tick marks at intervals of 10. For each language family, there are three adjacent bars representing the task count for each model. The mBERT bars are light teal, the XLM-R bars are medium teal, and the “same” bars are dark teal. For “IE-Baltic”, the mBERT bar reaches approximately 9, the XLM-R bar reaches approximately 14, and the “same” bar reaches approximately 6. The tallest bars are for “IE-Slavic”, with mBERT at approximately 37, XLM-R at approximately 32, and “same” at approximately 26. The bars are grouped by language family, with each group containing one bar for each model type. No bars are visually emphasized or annotated.
